{{Top}}
A '''heuristic processor''' was an advanced processor, a step up from the standard [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Processor/Legends|processor]]. The heuristic processor allowed a droid to learn by doing, rather than knowing and usually without instruction, which enabled droids to reason through several potential solutions to tasks and formulate the best approach.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''
